title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics enhancements and SLO toolkit integration
author: Lina Chen
commits: feat: add prioritized diagnostics pipeline with weighted scoring
chore: wire up slo-toolkit hints to incident-bot suggestions
feat: runbook quicklink enrichment with SLO context
test: add unit + integration tests for diagnostics heuristics
fix: debounce runbook lookup to avoid rate limits
description:
Context:
The oncall experience currently surfaces runbook links and a flat set of diagnostics. As incidents scale we need more focused, prioritized diagnostics and better SLO-aware hints so responders can act faster. This PR adds a prioritized diagnostics pipeline, integrates SLO hints from the slo-toolkit, and improves runbook linking relevance.

Motivation:
- Reduce mean time to acknowledge/mitigate by surfacing higher-confidence diagnostics first.
- Provide SLO-aware hints so oncall knows if an alert is likely to impact customer SLAs.
- Reduce noise from low-quality runbook links and avoid runbook lookup rate limit errors.

What this changes:
- internal/diagnostics: implement weighted scoring of candidate diagnostics (signals: error rate deltas, latency percentiles, recent deploys, trace anomalies). Scoring weights are configurable via configmap.
- internal/slo_hints: new adapter that queries slo-toolkit (cached) for SLA impact and returns structured hint strings used in messages.
- internal/runbooks: improved linker that prioritizes runbooks by semantic match + signal overlap and debounces external runbook service requests to avoid rate limiting.
- telemetry: emit diagnostic_priority_score and slo_hint_present events for observability.
- UI: oncall panel now shows top-3 suggested diagnostics and an SLO badge when an SLO hint is present.
- Tests: unit tests for scoring logic, integration test that exercises runbook linking and SLO hint flow.
- Docs: docs/runbooks.md updated with linker behavior and config knobs.

Checklist:
- [x] Add weighted diagnostics pipeline + config knobs
- [x] Integrate SLO hints from slo-toolkit and add caching layer
- [x] Update UI to surface prioritized diagnostics and SLO badges
- [x] Add unit and integration tests
- [x] Add telemetry events and dashboards (dashboard PR will follow)
- [x] Update docs/runbooks.md

Testing:
- Unit tests: new table-driven tests cover edge cases for scoring and runbook ranking.
- Integration: ran diagnostics integration test against local test cluster; initial run failed due to a flaky external-runbook API call, added debounce and retry logic; re-ran and tests passed.
- CI: a flaky integration test caused one CI run to show failure; retried the job which subsequently passed. All checks green at merge.

Rollout plan:
- Feature is gated behind a config flag incident_bot.enable_prioritized_diagnostics (default false). We'll enable in canary region for 24h and monitor diagnostic_priority_score and responder feedback. If stable, enable globally and iterate.

Backward compatibility and safety:
- Default behavior unchanged while flag is off.
- Runbook linker fallbacks to existing behavior if semantic scoring fails.
- Telemetry uses non-PII IDs only.

Related tickets:
- Linear: ENG-2345 (prioritized oncall diagnostics), ENG-2399 (slo-toolkit adapter)
